text: The applicant was born in 1954.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The applicant lives in Ashtarak, Armenia.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The applicant is the chairman of a regional branch of the Republic Party («Հանրապետություն» կուսակցություն).
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: In 2003 a presidential election was held in Armenia.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The first round of the 2003 Armenian presidential election took place on 19 February 2003.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The second round of the 2003 Armenian presidential election took place on 5 March 2003.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: Following the first and second rounds of the 2003 Armenian presidential election, a series of protest rallies were organised in Yerevan by the opposition parties.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: On 20 February 2003 the applicant participated in a demonstration held in Yerevan.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The demonstration held in Yerevan on 20 February 2003 was apparently followed by a march.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: On 26 February 2003 another demonstration was apparently supposed to take place in Yerevan.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: On 26 February 2003 the applicant and two other members of the Republic Party set off by car from Ashnak village to Yerevan.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The applicant alleged that on the road to Yerevan their car was stopped by several individuals in civilian clothes.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The applicant alleged that the individuals who stopped their car introduced themselves as officers of the Aragatsotn Regional Police Department.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The applicant and his colleagues were taken to the Aragatsotn Regional Police Department.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: From the Aragatsotn Regional Police Department, the applicant was transferred to the Central District Police Department of Yerevan.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: At the Central District Police Department of Yerevan, an administrative case was initiated against the applicant on account of his participation in the demonstration of 20 February 2003.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: On 26 February 2003, several hours after being brought to the Central District Police Department of Yerevan, the applicant was taken to the Kentron and Nork-Marash District Court of Yerevan (Երևան քաղաքի Կենտրոն և Նորք-Մարաշ համայնքներկ առաջին ատյանի դատարան).
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: At the Kentron and Nork-Marash District Court of Yerevan, the applicant was brought before Judge A.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: Judge A. heard the applicant and his lawyer before delivering the sentence.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: After a brief hearing, Judge A. sentenced the applicant under Article 180.1 of the Code of Administrative Offences (Վարչական իրավախախտումների վերաբերյալ ՀՀ օրենսգիրք – "the CAO") to ten days of administrative detention.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: Judge A. found that on 20 February 2003 the applicant participated in an unauthorised march, thus violating the prescribed rules for organising and holding street marches and demonstrations.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: Judge A. found that for the act of participating in an unauthorised march, the applicant was brought to the Central District Police Department on 26 February 2003.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: Judge A. found that the fact of the applicant's participation in an unauthorised march was confirmed by the explanation given by the applicant in court and the examination of the materials of the administrative case file.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The decision of the Kentron and Nork-Marash District Court of Yerevan stated that it was not subject to appeal.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The decision of the Kentron and Nork-Marash District Court of Yerevan stated that it could be protested against only by the prosecutor.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: On 27 February 2003 the applicant's lawyer lodged an appeal with the Criminal and Military Court of Appeal (ՀՀ քրեական և զինվորական գործերով վերաքննիչ դատարան) against the decision of the Kentron and Nork-Marash District Court of Yerevan.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: On 27 February 2003 the applicant's lawyer lodged an application with the General Prosecutor (ՀՀ գլխավոր դատախազ) requesting him to initiate an appeal against the decision of the Kentron and Nork-Marash District Court of Yerevan.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The applicant's lawyer argued, relying on various domestic provisions, that he was entitled to lodge an appeal against the decision of the Kentron and Nork-Marash District Court of Yerevan.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The applicant's lawyer submitted that the interference with the applicant's right to freedom of peaceful assembly was in violation of the Constitution of Armenia and was not prescribed by law.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The applicant's lawyer submitted that the penalty imposed on the applicant was excessive.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The applicant's lawyer attached a copy of the contested decision of the Kentron and Nork-Marash District Court of Yerevan to the appeal.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: On 2 March 2003 the President of the Criminal and Military Court of Appeal (ՀՀ քրեական և զինվորական գործերով վերաքննիչ դատարանի նախագահ) reviewed the applicant's conviction.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The President of the Criminal and Military Court of Appeal found that the applicant, according to the decision of the Kentron and Nork-Marash District Court of Yerevan, was subjected to administrative detention for violating the prescribed rules for organising and holding assemblies, demonstrations, street marches and rallies, by participating in an unauthorised demonstration and street march on 20 February 2003.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The President of the Criminal and Military Court of Appeal found, having familiarised himself with the applicant's appeal and the materials concerning the administrative offence, that the penalty imposed on the applicant must be changed.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The President of the Criminal and Military Court of Appeal changed the penalty imposed on the applicant to an administrative fine of 1,000 Armenian drams (AMD), approximately 1.5 euros (EUR) at the material time.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: The President of the Criminal and Military Court of Appeal ordered the applicant's release from detention.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: On 2 March 2003 the applicant was released from detention after having served approximately four days of his ten-day sentence.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: By a letter of 4 March 2003, the applicant's lawyer was informed by the General Prosecutor's Office (ՀՀ գլխավոր դատախազություն) that, on the basis of the applicant's appeal, the penalty had been changed by decision of the Criminal and Military Court of Appeal.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: By a letter of 4 March 2003, the applicant's lawyer was informed by the General Prosecutor's Office (ՀՀ գլխավոր դատախազություն) that the applicant had been released by decision of the Criminal and Military Court of Appeal.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: On 3 December 2003 the applicant supplemented his initial application to the Court with complaints about additional events.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: On 14 May 2003 the applicant participated in a demonstration held in Yerevan.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: On 21 May 2003 the applicant was taken to a police station.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: On 21 May 2003 the applicant was transported from a police station to the Kentron and Nork-Marash District Court of Yerevan.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: At the Kentron and Nork-Marash District Court of Yerevan, an administrative fine of 1,000 Armenian drams (AMD) was imposed on the applicant for having organised the participation of a group of people from his region in an unauthorised demonstration on 14 May 2003.
section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: A summary of the relevant provisions concerning administrative proceedings is contained in the judgment in the case of Galstyan v. Armenia (no. 26986/03, § 26, 15 November 2007).

A summary of the relevant legislation invoked by the parties in connection with Article 180.1 of the Code of Administrative Offences (the CAO) is contained in the judgment in the case of Mkrtchyan v. Armenia (no. 6562/03, §§ 20-28, 11 January 2007).
